name: Classic Fantasy
summary: Heroic journeys through rival kingdoms, dangerous roads, ancient ruins, and bright fellowship.

patterns.name: Border Kingdoms
patterns.summary: Defend small realms where wilderness, monsters, and old grudges meet.

patterns.name: War of Heirs
patterns.summary: Choose loyalties and shape a succession struggle across a divided crown.

patterns.name: Ruins of the Ancient Empire
patterns.summary: Explore fallen wonders whose treasures can remake the living world.

name: Dark Fantasy
summary: Desperate people confront curses, corrupt powers, and choices whose victories always carry a price.

patterns.name: Dying Marches
patterns.summary: Guard the last roads between settlements as the land slowly fails.

patterns.name: Witch Principalities
patterns.summary: Navigate rival courts whose bargains bind blood, memory, and weather.

patterns.name: Plague Pilgrimage
patterns.summary: Carry a fragile hope through quarantined provinces and haunted shrines.

name: Space Opera
summary: A daring crew explores ancient gates, contested systems, and civilizations poised for change.

patterns.name: Voidwake Archipelago
patterns.summary: Cross isolated star islands linked by unstable gates and old promises.

patterns.name: Sunforge Hegemony
patterns.summary: Resist or reform an empire powered by engineered suns and rigid duty.

patterns.name: Nightglass Frontier
patterns.summary: Build a future along a dark frontier filled with relics and rival crews.

summary: Street crews plan dangerous operations against systems that turn identity, loyalty, and survival into commodities.

patterns.summary: A flooded district builds its own utility network. Rescue tenants, prove deliberate outages and decide who owns the repair.

patterns.name: Ghost Transit
patterns.summary: An abandoned metro carries a missing courier's memories. Follow the signal, protect displaced sleepers and decide who may copy a person.

patterns.name: Road Clans
patterns.summary: Carry supplies and alliances across territories ruled by moving peoples.

patterns.name: Valley of Ancient Machines
patterns.summary: Settle a fertile valley where dormant machines shape every bargain.

patterns.name: Reclaimed Green Zone
patterns.summary: Protect a recovering ecosystem from hunger, ambition, and buried toxins.

name: Gothic Horror
summary: Investigators uncover intimate tragedies, seductive secrets, and monsters hidden behind respectable doors.

patterns.name: Stormbound Estates
patterns.summary: Endure a gathering of old families while a storm seals every road.

patterns.name: Gaslight City
patterns.summary: Trace occult crimes through crowded streets, salons, and hidden tunnels.

patterns.name: Cursed Province
patterns.summary: Break the compact that binds villages, nobles, and an ancient hunger.

name: Mythic Antiquity
summary: Heroes face prophecy, divine rivalry, and legendary trials in a world where every deed becomes a story.

patterns.name: Warring Poleis
patterns.summary: Balance civic duty, battlefield honor, and the demands of competing gods.

patterns.name: Islands of the Odyssey
patterns.summary: Sail between marvelous islands while fate tests every bond and promise.

patterns.name: Underworld Frontier
patterns.summary: Cross the border of death to recover names, truths, and unfinished lives.

name: Weird West
summary: Drifters, settlers, and outlaws confront supernatural debts across a frontier that remembers every injustice.

patterns.name: Cursed Frontier
patterns.summary: Protect scattered homesteads where broken treaties wake old powers.

patterns.name: Ghost Railway
patterns.summary: Ride a haunted line whose stations appear only to those who owe a debt.

patterns.name: Occult Boomtown
patterns.summary: Choose who controls a sudden fortune drawn from impossible ground.

summary: Ordinary obligations collide with hidden courts, magical neighborhoods, and bargains that reshape city life.

patterns.name: Hidden Courts
patterns.summary: Mediate rival supernatural courts concealed within familiar institutions.

patterns.name: Monster Districts
patterns.summary: Keep peace between communities whose strange needs cannot stay hidden.

patterns.name: Municipal Magic Conspiracy
patterns.summary: Follow permits, budgets, and disappearances into a civic occult machine.

summary: Investigators pursue impossible evidence while knowledge, isolation, and mounting pressure threaten everyone involved.

patterns.name: Coastal University
patterns.summary: Uncover a scholarly feud connected to tides, dreams, and missing archives.

patterns.summary: Survive isolation as an expedition discovers evidence beneath ancient ice.

patterns.name: Decaying Metropolis
patterns.summary: Trace impossible patterns through institutions of a city forgetting itself.

summary: Crews chase rumors across dangerous seas where empires, free captains, storms, and living myths compete.

patterns.name: Pirate Archipelago
patterns.summary: Build a free crew among hidden coves, rival captains, and shifting alliances.

patterns.name: Imperial Trade War
patterns.summary: Choose profit, principle, or independence between competing naval powers.

patterns.name: Mythic Ocean
patterns.summary: Chart waters where islands move and every storm carries an old story.

name: Mecha & Kaiju
summary: Pilots and crews defend fragile communities while immense machines, monsters, and personal bonds bear the cost.

patterns.name: Defense Metropolis
patterns.summary: Protect a layered coastal city while every battle changes its districts.

patterns.name: Colony Rebellion
patterns.summary: Fight a mobile campaign where pilots must decide what liberation costs.

patterns.name: Machine-Wreck Frontier
patterns.summary: Salvage colossal ruins while dormant threats and rival crews awaken.
